Summary: Implement authentication authorization and configuration security
Description: JWT auth. ACL enforcement: search results filtered to documents the user has read permission for. Connector credentials encrypted. Config validation at startup. Admin role for connector management.
Business Value: ACL enforcement is the primary security requirement — wrong results violate privacy.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Unauth → 401. 2. User without permission cannot see restricted document in search results. 3. Connector credentials encrypted. 4. Admin role required for connector management. 5. Missing env vars → startup failure.
Technical Notes: JWT with python-jose. user_id and groups from JWT payload. ACL filter: WHERE acl_records.principal_id IN (user_id, ...user_groups) AND permission != 'none'. See .kiro/steering/security.md.
Testing Requirements: Security tests: 401, ACL bypass attempt (user without permission sees 0 results for restricted doc), connector credential isolation.
Security Requirements: Connector credentials encrypted. ACL enforced at query time.
Definition of Done: Auth and ACL tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Document crawling and connector framework
Description: Implement connector framework: ConnectorAdapter interface with crawl() → documents. Implement: FilesystemConnector (local directory), URLListConnector (crawl list of URLs). Crawl queue in Redis. Incremental crawl (only changed files).
Business Value: Connectors are how content gets into the index.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. FilesystemConnector crawls test directory and enqueues documents. 2. URLListConnector fetches and enqueues URL list. 3. Incremental crawl: unchanged files skipped. 4. Crawl errors logged; failed documents marked failed. 5. Unit test for each connector.
Technical Notes: ConnectorAdapter interface: crawl(config) → Iterator[RawDocument]. Incremental: compare file hash to documents.content_hash. Store connector config encrypted.
Testing Requirements: Unit: connectors with mocked HTTP/filesystem. Integration: crawl → documents enqueued.
Security Requirements: Connector credentials encrypted. External URLs fetched with timeout and content size limit.
Definition of Done: Connectors tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Document parsing and indexing pipeline
Description: Implement: parse raw document to text (PDF, HTML, Markdown, TXT). Chunk text. Generate embeddings (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small via adapter). Store chunks and embeddings in DB. Update ACL records from source metadata. Mark document indexed_at.
Business Value: Indexing pipeline converts raw content to searchable chunks.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. PDF, HTML, Markdown, TXT parsed correctly. 2. Embeddings generated and stored. 3. ACL records created per document. 4. indexed_at updated. 5. Unit test for each parser.
Technical Notes: Parser: use BeautifulSoup for HTML, PyMuPDF for PDF. Chunking: sentence-aware with 512 token max and 64 token overlap. Embedding batch: 100 chunks per call.
Testing Requirements: Unit: parsers with fixture files. Integration: crawl → index pipeline.
Security Requirements: Embedding API key in env var. Content not in structured logs.
Definition of Done: Indexing pipeline tested end-to-end. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Keyword search (BM25/full-text)
Description: Implement keyword search using PostgreSQL full-text search (tsvector/tsquery). Build tsvector on chunk content. BM25-style ranking with ts_rank_cd. Filter by ACL. Return ranked chunks with snippet.
Business Value: Keyword search handles exact-match and acronym queries that semantic search misses.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Keyword search returns relevant chunks for exact-match query. 2. ACL filter applied. 3. Chunks ranked by relevance. 4. Snippet (surrounding text) returned. 5. Unit test for keyword ranking.
Technical Notes: tsvector updated on insert. ts_rank_cd(tsvector, tsquery) for ranking. ACL filter: JOIN with acl_records WHERE principal_id IN user_groups. Snippet: ts_headline().
Testing Requirements: Unit: keyword search with test chunks. Security: ACL filter test (restricted chunk not returned).
Security Requirements: ACL filter always applied in keyword search.
Definition of Done: Keyword search tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Vector/semantic search
Description: Implement semantic search: embed query (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small), query pgvector HNSW index with cosine similarity. Filter by ACL. Return top-20 chunks with scores. Apply ACL filter as a WHERE clause before vector search.
Business Value: Semantic search catches conceptually relevant results that keyword search misses.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Semantic search returns relevant chunks for synonym query. 2. ACL filter applied (WHERE clause, not post-filter). 3. Top-20 results returned. 4. Unit test with mocked embedding adapter.
Technical Notes: pgvector query: SELECT ... ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 WHERE acl_filter LIMIT 20. ACL as WHERE clause (not post-filter) for correctness.
Testing Requirements: Unit: semantic search with mocked embeddings. Security: ACL filter test.
Security Requirements: ACL filter as WHERE clause — not post-filter. Embedding API key in env var.
Definition of Done: Semantic search tested. ACL test passes. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Hybrid search fusion
Description: Implement hybrid search: run keyword and semantic in parallel, fuse with RRF (k=60). Return fused top-20. Apply ACL before fusion. Expose via POST /v1/search. Return results with source, title, snippet, score, acl_verified=true.
Business Value: Hybrid search consistently outperforms either method alone.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Hybrid search returns better top-5 than keyword-only or semantic-only for test queries. 2. ACL filter applied before fusion. 3. Results include source and snippet. 4. acl_verified=true in all results. 5. Unit test for RRF fusion.
Technical Notes: RRF fusion: score = 1/(60 + rank_keyword) + 1/(60 + rank_semantic). Run both searches in parallel (asyncio.gather). ACL applied in each sub-search. See .kiro/specs/project-08/spec.md.
Testing Requirements: Unit: RRF fusion. Integration: hybrid search pipeline. Security: ACL consistency test.
Security Requirements: ACL applied in each sub-search (not only in fusion output).
Definition of Done: Hybrid search tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Query rewriting and expansion
Description: Implement query rewriter: LLM expands query with synonyms and related terms. Output: rewritten_query string. Store rewritten_query in search_queries table. A/B comparison: run original and rewritten query, take better result. Configurable (on/off).
Business Value: Query rewriting improves recall for domain-specific queries.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Rewriter produces rewritten query for test input. 2. Rewritten query stored in search_queries. 3. Query rewriting on/off configurable. 4. Unit test with mocked LLM. 5. Rewritten query latency < 300ms.
Technical Notes: Rewriter prompt: expand enterprise query; output { rewritten_query: string, expansions: [string] }. Validate with Pydantic. Fallback: use original query if rewriter fails. See .kiro/specs/project-08/spec.md.
Testing Requirements: Unit: query rewriter with mocked LLM. Integration: search with rewriting enabled.
Security Requirements: LLM API key in env var. Original query stored — not rewritten query in logs.
Definition of Done: Query rewriter tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Reranking pipeline
Description: Implement reranker: take top-20 hybrid results, rerank with cross-encoder (ms-marco-MiniLM local or Cohere Rerank via adapter). Return top-5 with reranked scores. Configurable. Log rerank latency.
Business Value: Reranking improves precision in top-5 results.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Reranker returns top-5 from top-20. 2. Reranked order differs from hybrid order on test queries. 3. Reranker on/off configurable. 4. Latency logged. 5. Unit test with mocked adapter.
Technical Notes: Reranker adapter pattern. Local: cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2. Cohere: CohereRerankAdapter. Config: RERANKER_PROVIDER=local|cohere.
Testing Requirements: Unit: reranker with mocked adapter. Integration: hybrid → reranker → top-5.
Security Requirements: Reranker API key in env var (if Cohere).
Definition of Done: Reranker tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: ACL-based access control filtering
Description: Implement and test ACL enforcement: (1) at index time: ACL records created from connector metadata. (2) At search time: WHERE clause filters to user-permitted documents. Security test: user without permission sees 0 results for restricted document.
Business Value: ACL is the security foundation — wrong results violate enterprise privacy.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Restricted document not returned in search for unauthorized user. 2. Same document returned for authorized user. 3. Group-based permissions work. 4. ACL records updated on connector re-crawl. 5. Security test: ACL bypass attempt → 0 results.
Technical Notes: ACL filter: acl_records JOIN with user_id and user_groups from JWT. Always applied before any result is returned. Tested with 2 users and 1 restricted document.
Testing Requirements: Security tests: (1) unauthorized user → 0 results for restricted doc. (2) authorized user → doc returned. (3) ACL applied even if request param tries to bypass.
Security Requirements: ACL is in WHERE clause — cannot be bypassed by request parameters.
Definition of Done: ACL security test passes. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Search analytics and query logging
Description: Implement: log all search queries (query text anonymized), record click events (which result was clicked at which rank), compute zero-result rate, expose analytics endpoints. Dashboard: top queries, zero-result queries, click-through rate.
Business Value: Analytics drive search quality improvement.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Search queries logged (anonymized user ID). 2. Click events recorded. 3. GET /v1/analytics/zero-results returns zero-result queries. 4. Click-through rate computed. 5. Dashboard shows top queries.
Technical Notes: Anonymize: store user_id_hash instead of user_id in search_queries. Click events: POST from frontend on result click. Zero-result: result_count=0.
Testing Requirements: Unit: analytics queries. Integration: search → click → analytics.
Security Requirements: user_id hashed in search_queries. No PII in analytics.
Definition of Done: Analytics tested. Human reviewer approved.
